blocks.text: Fire Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) — Fire and safety maintenance Dubai
Firestone is a leading fire maintenance company in Dubai, providing fire fighting AMC with regular inspection, testing, and servicing of fire alarm and suppression systems.

A Fire Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) is a DCD-approved service agreement to inspect, test, and maintain a property's fire alarm, fire fighting, and fire safety equipment on a scheduled basis. Fire maintenance under this contract covers fire alarm maintenance, fire fighting system maintenance, fire pump testing, and fire equipment maintenance through regular PPM (planned preventive maintenance) visits. Firestone provides DCD-approved Fire AMC services across Dubai, with civil defence-approved technicians and compliance reporting prepared for Istifa renewal."
Why DCD-Approved Fire AMC Matters for Fire Maintenance in Dubai

Dubai Civil Defence (DCD) requires all commercial, residential, and industrial buildings to maintain an active Fire AMC covering fire alarm maintenance and fire fighting maintenance, verified during Istifa certificate renewal. Without a valid Fire AMC, buildings risk failed civil defence inspections, delayed Istifa renewal, and undetected faults in fire alarm systems, fire pumps, or fire suppression systems between scheduled visits. Regular fire safety maintenance and fire equipment maintenance under a PPM-based AMC catches these issues early, keeping fire alarm and fire fighting systems functional and compliant year-round.

Firestone has held Category A civil defence approval since 2007, with active authorization from ADCD, DCD, SCD, and SIRA — one of the few Fire AMC providers approved across all four emirates rather than a single jurisdiction. Every Fire AMC contract includes scheduled fire alarm maintenance, fire fighting maintenance, and documented compliance reporting formatted for Istifa submission, prepared by the same technicians who carry out your fire maintenance, not a separate admin team disconnected from the work.

items.q: What is a Fire Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) in Dubai?
items.a: A Fire Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) in Dubai is a legally required service agreement with a Dubai Civil Defence (DCD) approved contractor to inspect, test, and maintain a property's fire alarm and fire fighting systems. It covers scheduled visits, compliance reporting, and system servicing throughout the contract period.

items.q: What does a Fire AMC in Dubai typically include?
items.a: A Fire AMC in Dubai typically includes maintenance of fire alarm systems (control panels, detectors, sounders), fire fighting equipment (sprinklers, hydrants, hose reels, fire pumps), fire extinguisher servicing, and compliance documentation for civil defence submission.

items.q: Is a Fire AMC mandatory in Dubai?
items.a: Yes. Dubai Civil Defence requires commercial and residential buildings to maintain an active, documented fire alarm and fire fighting maintenance contract, verified during Istifa certificate renewal.

items.q: Who is authorized to provide a Fire AMC in Dubai?
items.a: Only Category A civil defence-approved contractors are authorized to provide Fire AMC services in Dubai. Firestone Fire & Safety Systems holds this approval alongside ADCD, SCD, and SIRA authorization across the UAE.

items.q: How often does a Fire AMC include maintenance visits?
items.a: Fire AMC visits are typically scheduled quarterly, with additional testing cycles for fire pumps and suppression systems depending on building classification and civil defence requirements.

items.q: What is the difference between a Fire AMC and a one-time fire safety inspection?
items.a: A Fire AMC is an ongoing annual contract covering scheduled maintenance, testing, and compliance reporting, while a one-time inspection is a single assessment without recurring service or civil defence documentation support.

items.q: How does a Fire AMC relate to Istifa certificate renewal?
items.a: An Istifa certificate renewal in Dubai requires proof of an active fire alarm and fire fighting maintenance contract, making a Fire AMC a prerequisite for civil defence compliance sign-off.

items.q: What determines the cost of a Fire AMC in Dubai?
items.a: Fire AMC pricing is determined by the number of fire alarm devices, fire pump capacity, presence of suppression systems, building size, and required visit frequency.
